mismatches.exactInstruction: Ensure '.skip-link' remains positioned completely outside the viewport (e.g. top: -100px or visually-hidden offscreen) and only enters the viewport top when explicitly focused by keyboard navigation (`.skip-link:focus`).

mobileLayoutContract.touchTargets: Minimum 44px vertical height for inputs, buttons, and close controls.
